title: SMPrequirements
description: This Texture Pack adds - Anti-pumkin-blur, blue debrie, Anti-fishing-bober, low fire (for ground and body), red crit particals, and, red sweep hits
body: This texture pack made by 1INdeep adds a few things to make the players experience better by adding - **Low-fire** (makes fire lower for extra visabuilty), **Anti-pumkin-blur** (Removes the blur when wearing a carved pumkin),  **No-bober** (Removes the fishing bober just incase someone rods you), Highlighted debris (Highlights anchient debris to blue to make it more visable), **Red-sweep-hits and, critacals** (for coolness!) **Tiny cursor** (For better aim) PS works for 1.21.11 and below...
